purpose: Versioned evidence contract for the Property Return Twin. Stronger evidence replaces assumptions by supersession, never by erasure.

source_tiers.TIER_A: Official national statistical office / central bank / regulator / primary government source
source_tiers.TIER_B: Harmonised multilateral source such as BIS, OECD or Eurostat
source_tiers.TIER_C: Commercial, listing-derived or secondary market data

replacement_rule.invariant: Historical packs remain immutable; current.json may only advance to a reviewed pack.
